email.title: Progress email
email.intro: Recipients are the student and family addresses listed in the student record. Contacts who have explicitly opted out are excluded; other listed contacts are available even without a recorded opt-in.
email.languageHint: The Arabic version reads right to left. Choosing both sends one message containing both versions.
email.selectRecipient: Select at least one student or family contact
email.loadPreviewFailed: Unable to load the progress email preview
email.sendFailed: Failed to send the PLP progress email
email.resendQuestion: These recipients already received this update: {{emails}}. Send another copy?
email.historyEmpty: No progress email has been sent for this record yet.
email.historyFailed: Unable to load the delivery history

consent.title: PLP progress email preference
consent.loadFailed: Unable to load PLP email preferences.
consent.saveFailed: Unable to save PLP email preference.
consent.agreement: I agree to receive PLP progress updates at {{email}}. Opting in records your preference. Teachers may also send to contacts listed in the student record without an opt-in; if you opt in and later turn this off, teachers will not send to this address.
consent.optedOutOn: You opted out on {{date}}. Teachers will not send PLP progress emails to this address.
consent.noPreference: No preference is recorded. Teachers may send to this address if it is listed in the student record.

practice.title: Linked practice
practice.none: No spelling or MAP practice is linked to this goal yet.
practice.pickerHint: Only this student's own spelling sessions and MAP practice are listed. Labels come from the student records, not from the plan.
practice.loadFailed: Unable to load this student's practice.
practice.noCandidates: This student has no spelling or MAP practice left to link.
practice.aiNone: Nothing here fits this goal, so no link was suggested.
practice.aiUnavailable: AI suggestions are unavailable right now. You can still link practice yourself.
practice.aiFailed: Could not get suggestions. Try again.
practice.saveFailed: Could not save the linked practice.

logger.title: Observation log
logger.subtitle: Speak or type what you noticed. The class, time and your name are saved with it.
logger.stale: The information below may be out of date.
logger.lessonOpenHint: Saved with this lesson while it is running.
logger.homeroomOpenHint: Saved from your homeroom class, without a period.
logger.offDay: Today is not a school day, so no lesson is open.
logger.noLesson: No lesson right now, and no homeroom class is assigned to you. Ask your admin to assign one.
logger.dictateUnsupported: This browser can’t take dictation. Type the observation instead.
logger.promptPlaceholder: For example: Sara helped a classmate who was stuck, then finished her own work quietly.
logger.promptHelp: Click the microphone and speak, or type. Edit the text before saving if needed.
logger.promptHelpTyped: Type what you noticed. Edit the text before saving if needed.
logger.reviewHint: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
logger.noMatch: No student selected yet. Pick from the class list below.
logger.incidentNote: Incidents are kept for staff records and are not included in family updates.
logger.tagHint: Optional, but required when you log for more than one student at once.
logger.detailHint: This wording is saved on the record.
logger.feedEmpty: Nothing has been logged for this class today.
logger.errNoText: Say or type what you noticed first.
logger.errClosed: Logging is closed for this class right now.
logger.errNoDetail: Add the detail that will be saved.
logger.errNeedTag: Pick a character tag when logging for more than one student.
logger.errRead: Couldn’t read that note. Try again.
logger.errSpeech: This browser can’t take dictation. Type the observation instead.
logger.errMicBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type instead.
logger.errVoice: Dictation stopped. Type the observation instead.
logger.aboutWhomHint: Pick students first, or just say their names in your note.
logger.noRoster: No students are enrolled in this class yet.
logger.feedSearchPlaceholder: Search a name, a tag or words in a note
